nodes.rationale: Provide one local workspace for browsing, previewing, editing, searching, and managing Markdown files.

nodes.label: Flask Web Application
nodes.rationale: Use a single-process local Flask service as the application and API boundary.

nodes.label: Local Markdown Filesystem
nodes.rationale: Keep Markdown content local and scope all operations to a selected base directory.

nodes.label: Markdown Rendering Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Centralize Markdown conversion, frontmatter extraction, syntax highlighting, Mermaid, math, tables, and table-of-contents support.

nodes.label: Live Reload via SSE
nodes.rationale: Notify browser clients of Markdown changes without polling or full application restarts.

nodes.label: Watchdog File Observer
nodes.rationale: Detect local Markdown changes with debouncing before notifying connected clients.

nodes.label: Path Validation Boundary
nodes.rationale: Resolve user-provided paths and enforce containment under the selected base directory to prevent traversal.

nodes.label: File Tree Cache
nodes.rationale: Avoid repeated directory scans while invalidating whenever file state changes.

nodes.label: Render Cache
nodes.rationale: Reuse rendered HTML with a path, modification-time, and size key so same-mtime writes do not remain stale.

nodes.label: REST API Surface
nodes.rationale: Expose file, search, editor, export, directory, and assistant operations through JSON endpoints.

nodes.label: Filename Search
nodes.rationale: Retain lightweight filename and path search as the default mode.

nodes.label: Full-Text Content Search
nodes.rationale: Add case-insensitive body-text discovery with contextual snippets while avoiding an index or advanced operators in the first iteration.

nodes.label: Search Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: Keep one familiar search bar and make content search explicitly opt in.

nodes.label: Search Snippet Results
nodes.rationale: Show path, line number, nearby context, and highlighted matches with a 50-result cap.

nodes.label: Content Search Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Coordinate backend route, sidebar toggle, result rendering, styling, and verification for full-text search.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible AI Assistant
nodes.rationale: Allow optional document-aware assistance through a configurable local or remote chat-completions endpoint.

nodes.label: CodeMirror Editor
nodes.rationale: Provide an in-browser editor with live preview, formatting controls, keybinding modes, and version history.

nodes.label: Standalone HTML Export
nodes.rationale: Produce a portable document with inlined styling.

nodes.label: Theme System
nodes.rationale: Offer Terminal, Amber, Dracula, Nord, and Paper appearances with a low-effects option.

nodes.label: Base Layout Template
nodes.rationale: Provide the shared sidebar, search controls, modals, theme menu, and frontend script shell.

nodes.label: File Browser Template
nodes.rationale: Render the landing page and recursive Markdown file tree.

nodes.label: Document View Template
nodes.rationale: Compose reading, outline, editing, exporting, diagram, math, and assistant experiences for one document.

nodes.label: Tabbed Document Rail
nodes.rationale: Separate the outline and assistant into tabs so chat history does not bury document navigation.

nodes.label: Readable Prose Typography
nodes.rationale: Use sans or serif prose faces for long-form reading while retaining monospace for headings and code.

nodes.label: UI Accessibility Backlog
nodes.rationale: Improve secondary-text contrast, touch targets, and high-contrast preference handling.

nodes.label: Future Git Integration
nodes.rationale: Expose file status and inline diffs in the Markdown file tree.

nodes.label: Future PDF and Word Export
nodes.rationale: Extend sharing beyond the existing standalone HTML export.

nodes.label: Future Command Palette
nodes.rationale: Provide keyboard-first access to search, themes, and editor commands.

nodes.label: Future Presentation Mode
nodes.rationale: Turn Markdown sections into a full-screen slideshow.

nodes.label: Future Real-Time Collaboration
nodes.rationale: Enable multiple local-network users to edit together with live cursors.

nodes.label: Example Markdown Corpus
nodes.rationale: Provide manual fixtures demonstrating supported Markdown features.

nodes.label: Syntax Highlighting Examples
nodes.rationale: Exercise fenced code rendering across several languages.

nodes.label: Tables and Lists Examples
nodes.rationale: Exercise table, list, blockquote, table-of-contents, and mixed-content rendering.

nodes.label: Rail Smoke Outline Fixture
nodes.rationale: Provide a minimal heading hierarchy for document-outline smoke checks.

nodes.label: Runtime Entry Trace Finding
nodes.rationale: Preserve the prior finding that the executable path is connected while project documentation lacked implementation edges.

nodes.label: Graph Quality Review Finding
nodes.rationale: Preserve the prior portability and semantic-fidelity diagnosis while distinguishing it from application defects.
